title: DocumentFileStatus
description: An object represent a document's status

DocumentId.description: Gets or sets the document identifier.

DrawerId.description: Identifier of drawer the document belongs to

DocumentStatusException.description: Gets or sets an exception while retrieving status

IsFiled.description: Gets or sets whether the document is filed or not

IsUndergoingMerging.description: Whether the document is undergoing merging process or not.

IsInTaxsortQueue.description: Whether the document is undergoing taxsorting process or not.

IsInRedactionQueue.description: Whether the document is undergoing redaction process or not.

IsLocked.description: Whether the document is locked or not.

IsCheckedOut.description: Whether the document is checked out or not.

IsArchived.description: Whether the document is archived or not.

IsPublished.description: Whether the document is published or not.

IsOfficeDocument.description: Whether it is an office document or not

Reviewed.description: Whether document is reviewed or not

TaxSort.description: Whether document is taxsorted or not

IsEncrypted.description: Whether document is encrypted or not

IsApproved.description: Whether the document is approves or not.
